question: Can a blank numerical action circuit grow nonlinear features from contradictory experience without a supplied degree ceiling or enumeration of candidate supports?
hypothesis: Counterexample minimization plus sparse XOR-of-conjunction weight construction will recover some higher-order sparse mechanisms outside WSP40's degree<=3 vocabulary. Multiple-term cancellation and arbitrary functions may defeat bounded greedy discovery; preserve the failures.
world: Known cyclic state rotation plus scalar XOR residual into bit0. Single degree6 uses random six distinct inputs. Four/eight mixed use distinct uniformly sampled supports of degrees1..6 XORed. Arbitrary residual uses SHA256 of fixed world tag, action, state &1, representing an unstructured deterministic function. Learner only receives width and probe replies; no source/family/seed/support.
learner: Start zero terms. Probe stream cycles all-ones and pseudorandom states with densities.5/.75/.875, seed977+width, independent of world. On contradiction, greedily delete set bits in increasing index while residual relative to current model stays1. Write resulting support to numeric AND weights/threshold and XOR coefficient; toggle existing support. Supports may have any degree0..width. Limit32 cells/action,512 updates/action; on capacity or budget stop preserve current candidate. Cached real replies do not cause new oracle calls; all resident cache/steps/queries counted. Replay first cached contradiction before selecting new source probe. No brute-force candidate mask enumeration.
controls: same-active-transcript independent symbolic execution of learned supports (runtime parity, not independent discovery)
fully fitted conventional Hamming RBF kernel least-squares interpolation same active transcript, k=2^(-Hamming), threshold.5
same-budget random-transcript fully fitted identical RBF
trained: Exact Cholesky solve K alpha=y for distinct source states, positive-definite Hamming kernel, no regularizer or early stop. Require max train residual<=1e-7 per action or mark trained comparator unqualified. Capacity n_observations floating coefficients plus n_observations raw state centers; different prior/capacity explicitly measured. This is trained conventional kernel regression, not a fully trained neural comparator.

tests.heldout: sample with replacement excluding active probe states. Controls with other transcripts may have seen states; count explicitly.
tests.cold: exact snapshot restore and corruption rejection
tests.retention: freeze first-world weights while learning one separate world, count additional acquisition queries
tests.repair: report all cached contradictions remaining after construction, no perfect-fit filtering

metrics: cold retention, corruption and independent-world isolation

thresholds.engineering: all prior full regression plus WSP41 tests, atlas and clean source on Windows/Linux, identical integer metric and trace
thresholds.bounded: all single_degree6 active128 episodes >=95% one-step,>=90% composition,>=90% plans; report every mixed family and budget without tuning
thresholds.scientific: DEV_SUPPORTED only for preset bounded thresholds, MIXED/NEGATIVE otherwise. No SCIENTIFIC_PASS without independent unfamiliar domain, matched strongest fully trained neural control and whole-process comparison. Symbolic runtime agreement is not control evidence for learning superiority.

authority: External bounded synthetic contributor draft only; no merge/main/accepted refs, official research, self-hosted runner, protected first-use, controller, scheduler, live action, paid API or deployment.
limits: Generic search, probing, minimization and allocation are externally written Python software, not learned or numeric internal cognition.
AND/XOR/rotation operator family is supplied; removing degree ceiling does not discover new computational primitives.
Synthetic memberships are experience; zero gradients is not zero learning or zero data.
Arbitrary unknown knowledge cannot be reconstructed without informative evidence.
